related_questions.question: Which bank gives 7% interest on savings accounts?

text_blocks.snippet: Currently, it's very difficult to find a bank offering a 7% APY on a standard savings account. However, some credit unions offer high-yield checking accounts with rates at or above 7%. For example, BCU offers 8% on qualifying deposits for a limited time. Additionally, some credit unions like WECU offer 7% APY on their kids' savings accounts.

list.title: Credit Unions:

list.title: High-Yield Checking:

list.title: Limited-Time Offers:
list.snippet: Be aware that some high-yield offers are for a limited time or require meeting specific criteria, like a minimum deposit or qualifying transactions.

list.title: WECU Kids Savings:

list.title: BCU PowerPlus Checking:
list.snippet: BCU's PowerPlus Checking account can double the APY on the first $15,000 for new members for a limited time.

related_questions.question: What is the interest rate for Kotak savings account?

text_blocks.snippet: Kotak Mahindra Bank offers various savings accounts with different interest rates. For instance, the Kotak 811 Edge Digital Savings Account offers up to 3.50% interest, while the Edge Savings Account for premium banking offers 2.50% p.a. on daily balances. The bank also offers 2.50% p.a. on NRE/NRO savings accounts, effective July 9, 2025. Interest rates can be subject to change at the bank's discretion.

list.snippet: Kotak 811 Edge Digital Savings Account: Offers up to 3.50% interest.
Edge Savings Account: Offers 2.50% p.a. on daily balances for both resident and non-resident accounts (NRE/NRO).
NRE/NRO Savings Account: Offers 2.50% p.a., effective July 9, 2025.
General Savings Account: The bank offers 2.50% p.a. on savings accounts across all account balances.
Senior Citizen Savings Account: The Grand Savings Account offers 7.10% interest rates.
ActivMoney Feature: Some savings accounts, like the Grand Savings Account, offer an ActivMoney feature that allows customers to earn FD-like interest rates.
Interest Calculation: Interest is calculated daily on the balance in the savings account.
Impact of Balance and Time: The amount of interest earned is influenced by the account balance and the length of time the money is held in the account.
Other Factors: Interest rates can also be affected by the type of account (e.g., domestic vs. NRE/NRO) and any special features like the ActivMoney feature.
